Across frames 3 to 5, the camera wearer turns and steps rightward to face the dark board directly in front of them, bringing a second person crouching on the far left side of the board (about 1.5 to 2 metres from the wearer) into full view in frames 4 and 5. This crouching person faces downward and slightly rightward toward the board—looking at the metal bar and handheld grinder within their own arm's reach rather than toward the camera wearer—while additional longer metal bars lie on the right half of the board about 0.3 to 0.6 metres to the person's left. Behind and above the crouching person in the upper background (roughly 2 to 3 metres from the wearer), a yellow welding machine, a small platform scale, and plastic containers sit near the wall, partially occluded by the crouching person and the top edge of the frame.
